text:
Cross-functional app delivery process

The lanes are representative because the platform’s specific roles and terminology were not supplied.

Diagram
flowchart LR
  subgraph U[User and Business]
    direction TB
    A[Submit idea and desired outcome]
    B[Clarify users scope and success measures]
    C[Perform user acceptance]
    D[Review outcomes and feedback]
  end

  subgraph P[Product and Governance]
    direction TB
    E[Capture application record]
    F[Classify complexity risk and criticality]
    G{Initiative approved}
    H[Fund prioritize and create backlog]
    I{Acceptance and release approved}
    J[Prioritize improvements]
  end

  subgraph X[Architecture Security and Data]
    direction TB
    K[Design experience architecture data and integrations]
    L[Assess security privacy and compliance]
    M{Design and residual risk accepted}
  end

  subgraph E1[Engineering and Delivery]
    direction TB
    N[Provision environments repositories and pipeline]
    O[Build application and integrations]
    P1[Run automated quality and security checks]
    Q{Quality gates passed}
    R[Package release migration and rollback]
    S[Remediate defects or incidents]
  end

  subgraph T[Quality Assurance]
    direction TB
    T1[Test function integration performance accessibility and recovery]
  end

  subgraph O1[Release and Operations]
    direction TB
    U1[Deploy progressively to production]
    V[Validate health data and user journeys]
    W{Release healthy}
    X1[Operate monitor secure and support]
    Y[Measure usage reliability cost and outcomes]
    Z[Retire migrate or archive when approved]
  end

  A --> E --> B --> F --> G
  G -- No --> A
  G -- Yes --> H --> K --> L --> M
  M -- No --> K
  M -- Yes --> N --> O --> P1 --> Q
  Q -- No --> O
  Q -- Yes --> T1 --> C --> I
  I -- No --> H
  I -- Yes --> R --> U1 --> V --> W
  W -- No --> S --> O
  W -- Yes --> X1 --> Y --> D --> J --> H
  X1 --> Z
limitations: The functional lanes are generic because platform-specific components and role names were not provided.
